profile.headline: Software Engineering Professional
profile.summary: Software engineering professional with a deep interest in learning the most efficient way of doing things and in the latest and greatest technologies. Motivated in finding potential process and technological improvements. Self-starter with experience working on projects individually as well as enterprise software in an agile team environment.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Redesigned and migrated legacy SQL database to add foreign key constraints, fix normalization issues, remove duplicates, and improve performance
* Created a web API to access and update data using ASP.NET MVC and Newtonsoft Json.NET
* Implemented business layer using LINQ to SQL and custom data attributes for validation and persistence logic
* Created client-side reports with interactive filters, data visualizations, and export capabilities

company.name: National Center for Hearing Assessment and Management

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
* Updated existing programs to use newest internal libraries/binaries and added additional functionality as specified by our clients
* Utilized Linux tools (sed, awk, perl, find) and regex to format data files for testing and to ensure data was in correct input and output formats
* Tested programs to ensure output matched expected values before committing changes to production

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
* Provided Linux web hosting support for both technical and non-technical people
* Worked with clients to troubleshoot a variety of issues with MYSQL databases, email delivery, DNS propagation, and Apache server errors
* Configured DNS records and assisted clients with DNS issues
